# SmartAssPDF — Complete Technical, Architecture & Tool Knowledge Base

> SmartAssPDF is a private, open-source-oriented document utility platform providing 16 live conversion, merging, splitting, compression, and security tools.

---

## 1. Architecture & Privacy Principles

SmartAssPDF operates under a **Zero-Permanent-Storage Architecture**:
1. **Stateless Processing**: There is no user database, no account login requirement, and no credit card paywall.
2. **Isolated Job Directories**: Each upload is assigned a unique UUID temporary directory on the host server.
3. **Scheduled Cleanup**: All input files and converted outputs are scheduled for automatic hard deletion after 30 minutes.
4. **Dynamic Output Filenames**: Results retain the original uploaded filename base (e.g. `Invoice_2026.pdf` → `Invoice_2026.docx` or `Invoice_2026_compressed.pdf`).

---

## 2. Technology & Engine Specifications

- **Frontend**: High-performance static HTML5, CSS custom properties (Dark Mode default with instant light theme switcher), vanilla JavaScript ES6, SmartAss AI browser agent. Zero runtime telemetry.
- **Backend**: Spring Boot 3.5 on Java 17 LTS with Python Bridge Converter.
- **Document Engine**:
  - Apache PDFBox 3.0 for PDF manipulations, rasterization, font embedding, encryption, and page transformations.
  - Apache POI 5.x for reading and generating Microsoft Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), and PowerPoint (.pptx) structures.
  - PyMuPDF / fitz for high-speed layout parsing, table finding, and vector drawing analysis.
  - Tabula & OpenPyXL for structured tabular extraction and formula-ready Excel generation.
  - LibreOffice Headless for 100% layout-preserved Word, Excel, and HTML rendering.
  - Pillow / PIL for high-performance WebP image compression with alpha channel preservation.

---

## 3. Tool Specifications & Limitations

### PDF to Word (`/tools/pdf-to-word.html`)
- **Input**: Single PDF (`.pdf`) up to 50MB.
- **Output**: Native Microsoft Word document (`.docx`).
- **Processing**: High-fidelity page-canvas extraction preserving fonts, vector divider lines, table structures, and centered logos.

### PDF to Excel (`/tools/pdf-to-excel.html`)
- **Input**: Single PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Output**: Microsoft Excel workbook (`.xlsx`).
- **Processing**: Tabula + PyMuPDF table parsing with auto-fitted columns, numeric cell typing, and dark header styling.

### PDF to JPG (`/tools/pdf-to-jpg.html`)
- **Input**: Single PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Output**: Single JPG for 1-page documents, or a `.zip` archive containing numbered JPG images (`page-001.jpg`, etc.) for multi-page PDFs.
- **Options**: Selectable DPI rendering (100 DPI web, 150 DPI balanced, 200 DPI high-res, 300 DPI print).

### PDF to PowerPoint (`/tools/pdf-to-ppt.html`)
- **Input**: Single PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Output**: Microsoft PowerPoint presentation (`.pptx`).
- **Processing**: High-fidelity page-canvas slide generation with exact slide dimensions.

### Word to PDF (`/tools/word-to-pdf.html`)
- **Input**: Microsoft Word document (`.docx`).
- **Output**: Standard PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Processing**: Headless document compiler preserving 100% of formatting, margins, tables, and images.

### Excel to PDF (`/tools/excel-to-pdf.html`)
- **Input**: Microsoft Excel spreadsheet (`.xlsx`, `.xls`).
- **Output**: Paginated PDF document (`.pdf`).
- **Processing**: Renders genuine spreadsheet gridlines with cell borders and formulas.

### Image to WebP (`/tools/image-to-webp.html`)
- **Input**: Single or multiple image files (`.png`, `.jpg`, `.jpeg`) up to 20 files.
- **Output**: `.webp` image or `.zip` archive containing compressed WebP images.
- **Processing**: High-efficiency WebP compression preserving alpha transparency with configurable quality levels.

### Image to PDF (`/tools/image-to-pdf.html`)
- **Input**: Single or multiple image files (`.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.png`) up to 20 files.
- **Output**: Single consolidated PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Processing**: Scales and centers each image onto standard A4 pages preserving original aspect ratios.

### HTML to PDF (`/tools/html-to-pdf.html`)
- **Input**: Local HTML file (`.html`, `.htm`).
- **Output**: Visual rendered PDF document (`.pdf`).
- **Processing**: Renders full CSS styles, layouts, typography, and tables into PDF.

### Merge PDF (`/tools/merge-pdf.html`)
- **Input**: Two or more PDF files (`.pdf`) up to 20 files.
- **Output**: Single combined PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Processing**: Uses `PDFMergerUtility` to concatenate page trees and metadata in designated upload order.

### Split PDF (`/tools/split-pdf.html`)
- **Input**: Single PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Output**: Single PDF (for single range) or `.zip` archive (for multiple ranges).
- **Options**: Page range expressions (e.g. `1-3`, `5`, `8-12`).

### Compress PDF (`/tools/compress-pdf.html`)
- **Input**: Single PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Output**: Optimized PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Processing**: Multi-stage image downsampling and object stream optimization yielding 60-80% file size reduction.
- **Options**: Extreme (0.3), Balanced (0.5), High Quality (0.8).

### Rotate PDF (`/tools/rotate-pdf.html`)
- **Input**: Single PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Output**: Rotated PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Options**: Clockwise rotation by 90°, 180°, or 270°.

### Add Page Numbers (`/tools/add-page-numbers.html`)
- **Input**: Single PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Output**: Numbered PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Options**: Placement (Bottom Center, Bottom Left, Bottom Right, Top Center).

### Protect PDF (`/tools/protect-pdf.html`)
- **Input**: Single PDF (`.pdf`) and user password.
- **Output**: Encrypted PDF (`.pdf`).
- **Security**: Applies 256-bit AES encryption (`StandardProtectionPolicy`).

### Unlock PDF (`/tools/unlock-pdf.html`)
- **Input**: Protected PDF (`.pdf`) and password.
- **Output**: Unlocked, unencrypted PDF (`.pdf`).
